WITH GroupedData AS (
            SELECT 
                ISNULL(b.name, 'Unknown') AS [Segmen],
                f.bucket_awal AS [Bucket T0],
                f.periode_proyeksi AS [Periode Proyeksi],
                CAST(f.standard_error AS DECIMAL(10,6)) AS [Standard Error (SE)],
                MAX(CASE WHEN f.skenario = 'OPTIMIS' THEN CAST(f.z_macro_value AS DECIMAL(10,6)) END) AS [Z-Macro Optimis],
                MAX(CASE WHEN f.skenario = 'MODERAT' THEN CAST(f.z_macro_value AS DECIMAL(10,6)) END) AS [Z-Macro Moderat],
                MAX(CASE WHEN f.skenario = 'PESIMIS' THEN CAST(f.z_macro_value AS DECIMAL(10,6)) END) AS [Z-Macro Pesimis]
            FROM [ipsak413_mid]..fact_zmacro_projection f WITH (NOLOCK)
            LEFT JOIN [ipsak71]..segment b WITH (NOLOCK) 
              ON f.id_klaster_pd = b.id AND b.KodeForm = 'PD'
            WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), f.periode_proyeksi, 120) BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      
            GROUP BY b.name, f.bucket_awal, f.periode_proyeksi, f.standard_error
        )
        SELECT *, COUNT(*) OVER() as total_rows
        FROM GroupedData
        ORDER BY [Segmen], [Bucket T0]
        OFFSET @Offset ROWS FETCH NEXT @Limit ROWS ONLY;
